name: Management
security_notes: Restricted to trusted admin systems only. No general user or IoT access.

name: Server
security_notes: Limited access from management VLAN and approved services only.

name: Client
security_notes: User devices should not directly access management infrastructure.

name: WLAN
security_notes: Wireless clients should have restricted east-west access and limited infrastructure access.

name: IoT
security_notes: Untrusted devices. Internet access only where possible. Block access to management and servers by default.

name: SECURITY
security_notes: Restricted to monitoring, logging, and security tooling. Highly trusted VLAN.

name: DICOM
security_notes: Restricted to imaging systems, PACS testing, and approved DICOM communication paths only.

name: BLACKHOLE
security_notes: Unused/native VLAN. Should not carry user traffic. Restrict access and avoid device assignment.
